body:
90 congruent unit squares fit in a square of side **4999138583463/500000000000 = 9.998277166926**, an improvement of **0.001722833074** over the side 10 listed in the [N90 case record](https://squaremath.org/cases/90.html). This establishes an upper bound. The exact optimum remains open.

Please credit **jazivxt and GPT-6 Astra Ultra**. [Kaggle profile](https://www.kaggle.com/jazivxt) · [Squares in Squares competition](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/squares-in-squares).

### Construction and lineage

We started with a rectangular crop of [Joost de Winter’s N157 packing](https://github.com/JoostdeWinter/square-packing/blob/c70defaf39af47db220d1e7c2922590637ffb664/n157/n157_exact.json). Shifting successive copies horizontally by one unit reduced their vertical spacing from approximately 9.353384 to 9.019403. A square window spanning two copies contained 90 tiles. We tightened their positions and orientations and converted the result to exact rational coordinates. GPT-6 Astra Ultra was the AI collaborator on the search and verification.

### Certificate and checks

[Exact certificate](https://github.com/dpre4ai/n90-square-packing/blob/179fcba7f0e91e2c3d3e92525e0738b6da0f8dd5/n90.cert) · [diagram](https://github.com/dpre4ai/n90-square-packing/blob/179fcba7f0e91e2c3d3e92525e0738b6da0f8dd5/n90.png) · [decimal CSV](https://github.com/dpre4ai/n90-square-packing/blob/179fcba7f0e91e2c3d3e92525e0738b6da0f8dd5/n90.csv). Pinned revision `179fcba7f0e91e2c3d3e92525e0738b6da0f8dd5`. Certificate SHA-256 `88c93b2f1d1f3061d1e6815f790d13f3d8f174dd3431f50d8d4d9d4383b3d466`.

The certificate lists exact rational centers and half-angle tangents. [Francisco Couzo’s public checker, based on Evan Daniel’s verifier](https://github.com/franciscouzo/square-packing/blob/712c6a6e9ef58a9521784e6b7e236af813422de7/verify_bound_certificate.py), accepted the witness in strict mode. It can be replayed with `python verify_bound_certificate.py --strict n90.cert`. A separate exact-arithmetic check tested all four walls per square and all 4,005 pairs. Both checks use rational arithmetic and the separating-axis criterion. The minimum pair separation on a certifying axis exceeded 1.19 × 10⁻¹². The claim has been checked computationally and is submitted here for independent registration.
title: 90 unit squares in side 9.998277166926 — upper-bound registration request
